protocol.status: exploratory retrospective protocol amendment; not preregistered or a live-controller run
protocol.deviation: source clip is 29.976489 s, so the 30 s proposal period cannot produce a transition; set proposal half-period to 10 s without selecting by recognition outcome
protocol.normalization: reuse recorded normalized_text; nonempty and score >= active threshold required
protocol.history: retain prior admitted votes; no resets; group by original application lifetime
protocol.controls: validate constant-gate replay against actual runs 21/22/23 at 0.30/0.46/0.77; the 0.50 and 0.80 constant controls are reconstructions
protocol.timebase: use source-video presentation timestamps indexed by frame_id; preserve export convention; check index-offset sensitivity
protocol.uncertainty: no manual passage ground truth; no accuracy or independent-session inference

frame_index_convention: Assumed zero-based for presentation; minus-one sensitivity does not change any reported emulation membership or winner. Convention requires source-code confirmation.
plot_timestamps: source PTS of OCR observations, not finalization times; emitted-event source times are not in these exports
